notes.title: The Unleashed Update (Alpha 1.4.0)
notes.content:
[h2]Unleashed Form[/h2]
After fusing 6 cards together across any number of battles, you will be able to enter your [b]unleashed[/b] form, which activates a powerful class-specific ability and empowers your fusion cards for 3 turns.

[h2]Quality of Life[/h2]
[list]
[*] Changed mana to blue
[*] Updated card design
[*] Added arc to cards in-hand while in battle
[*] Brought back functionality where the map scrolls you automatically to the next node after clearing the current node (and fixed for variable screen sizes)
[/list]

[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Removed debuff aspects of runes that had them
[*] Took a first pass at minor rune rebalancing - this will be a more complete effort in the near future
[*] Adjusted likelihood of certain nodes appearing at certain points on the map
[/list]

[h2]UI/UX[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated settings menu UI to align with ongoing UI updates for more uniformity
[*] Removed blue highlight when hovering a card that can't be interacted with - the new intention is for the blue highlight to indicate the card is interactable or is selected (like when choosing a target in battle)
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed display issue on some screen sizes with highlighted deck on deck selection screen
[*] Fixed situational crash when player takes status damage
[*] Minor bug fixes with card interactions in-hand
[*] Minor bug fixes with resolving card effects
[*] Minor bug fixes with enemies
[*] Fixed an issue with the hovered tooltip for runes
[*] Fixed a bug where additional effects paired with lethal damage would cause a crash under certain circumstances
[*] Fixed bug where current map progress was erased if you went to the main menu while viewing a node (i.e. while Forgotten Library cards are being shown or Mystic Forge cards are being fused)
[/list]

notes.title: Demo Update (Alpha 1.3.0)
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay[/h2]
[list]
[*] Overhauled the UI/UX for the deck selection screen.
[*] The deck you choose now also sets your health and starting gold amount.
[*] Minor updates to the realm selection UX to help align with the new deck selection screen.
[*] Removed Anima as a resource - the intent is for Anima to be repurposed in an upcoming new feature.
[*] Removed blur and motion from the intro logos - it felt unnecessary.
[*] Locked light, ice, and shadow decks for the demo.
[/list]


[h2]Cards[/h2]
[list]
[*] Increased the number of fusion cards - you should never end up with a hand of cards without potential fusion options!
[*] Reduced the number of base cards and simplified their effects. This should allow more room for translating card complexity from base cards to fusion cards, with more predictable outcomes. It is a game about fusing cards together, after all!
[*] Play the demo to see and unlock all of the newest cards in your compendium!
[/list]

[h2]What's next?[/h2]
[list]
[*] [b]Unleashed [/b]abilities - after fusing enough cards together, [b]Unleash [/b]your full power by triggering a class-specific ability and empowering your fusion cards.
[*] More runes and enemies
[*] More base cards and corresponding fusions
[*] Additional UI/UX enhancements
[/list]

Thank you all for your continued support, and please look forward to more updates in the near future!

notes.title: Demo Update (Alpha 1.2.0)
notes.content:
[h2]New Features[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added preview for fusions to see what your cards will fuse into (if you've created the fusion once before).
[*] Added meta progression for unlocking class cards (Up to level 3 for the demo version).
[*] Added ability to save and continue runs. Runs are automatically saved after each node, and when the player wins or loses a run.
[*] Added Compendium to view known cards, enemies, and runes.
[/list]

[h2]Enhancements[/h2]
[list]
[*] Updated UI for game over screen (experimental)
[*] Improved keyword tooltip behavior
[*] Deck selection now displays class level
[*] Rebalanced starting decks around certain cards that now must be unlocked via level progression
[/list]

[h2]Bug Fixes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed bug where deck was sometimes not clickable from the map
[*] Fixed bug where nodes could be interacted with while deck overlay was visible
[*] Fixed bug where notification would be stuck displaying if it was visible while returning to the main menu
[/list]

[h2]New cards[/h2]
[list]
[*] Icy Touch (fusion)
[*] Piercing Shadow (fusion)
[*] Winter Warning
[/list]

[h2]Updated cards[/h2]
Now that classes are self-contained, there were a number of fusions left on an island that used cards from multiple classes. This has been resolved by updating some fusion materials.
Additionally, some other fusion cards got needed updates, as they either felt unviable, or their fusion result didn't make sense given the fusion materials.
[list]
[*] Solar Flare - Fireball + Scorch = Deal 5 damage. Apply 2 burn.
[*] Radiant Ray - Scorch + Burn Up = Apply 2 burn to an enemy. Gain 1 spirit.
[*] Overheat - Burn Up + Burn Up = Discard your hand. Draw a card for each card discarded this way. Gain 1 spirit.
[*] Chilling Foresight - Frozen Spirit + Quick Draw = Gain 1 spirit. Draw 1 card.
[*] Drain - 2 damage -> 3 damage
[*] Nightmare Vision - 2 damage -> 3 damage | 1 health -> 2 health
[*] Soul Drain - 4 damage -> 6 damage
[*] Twilight Eruption - 8 damage -> 7 damage
[*] Purification - 2 health -> 3 health
[*] Shadow Strike - 6 damage -> 7 damage
[*] Vile Strike - 6 damage -> 7 damage
[/list]

[h2]Roadmap[/h2]
[list]
[*] Class-specific abilities that can be charged up by creating fusions in-battle
[*] Battle VFX
[*] Improve SFX
[*] Update Music
[*] More cards, runes and enemies
[/list]

Thank you for your support, and please look forward to more updates in the near future!

notes.title: Demo Update (Alpha 1.1.0)
notes.content:
[h2]Quality of Life Changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Card selections at Forgotten Library and Victory screens are now limited to cards from your class or certain neutral cards. This should encourage more helpful card choices and stronger synergies
[*] Now displays possible fusions from your deck in Forgotten Library and Victory card selections
[*] Shows keyword descriptions on hover instead of middle-click
[*] Shows keyword descriptions on hover for enemy attacks as well
[*] Enemies should vary their attacks more often, when it makes sense to
[*] Lengthened runs by adding 2 more nodes to the beginning of each run (1 enemy, and 1 event node which is weighted to be Forgotten Library most of the time)
[*] Tightened up wording of some keyword descriptors
[*] Added setting to enable/disable card keyword tooltips
[*] Add note to random events to clarify what could happen
[*] Rebalanced some enemies and rune gold costs
[*] Clarified that "dispel" cards are dispelled when played or fused
[*] Minor performance optimizations
[*] Various bugfixes
[/list]

[h2]Card Changes[/h2]
This time around, the Light deck is getting some major love. These changes should make it easier and more viable to lean into the block archetype. With the major buff to Shield Slam (maybe too major?), that block can meaningfully translate into big damage.

[h3]Card Buffs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Protect - 6 block -> 7 block
[*] Aegis - 5 block -> 6 block
[*] Shieldbane - 5 block -> 8 block
[*] Divine Intervention - Draw 2 cards. Restore 4 health
[*] Brimstone Armor - 1 burn -> 2 burn
[/list]

[h3]Card Nerfs[/h3]
[list]
[*] Hallowed Ground - 6 damage -> 5 damage
[*] Judgement - 8/16 damage -> 7/14 damage
[/list]

[h3]Card Reworks[/h3]
[list]
[*] Dissonant swing - Deal 5 damage and daze an enemy with block
[*] Shield slam - No longer removes block upon use
[*] Divine Blessing - Draw 1 card -> Restore 3 health
[*] New Dawn -> Survey - Draw 1 card for each living enemy
[*] Heroic Ruination - Deal 5 damage to all enemies. If any character is below half health, deal 12 damage instead
[*] Added descriptive text for Phoenix cards
[/list]

notes.title: Hand of Anima Demo Update (Alpha 1.0.3)
notes.content:
[h2]Bug fixes[/h2]
There were a bunch of random minor bug fixes, but most notably, the Mystic Forge [i]should [/i]be working properly now!

[h2]New keyword[/h2]
Piercing - Piercing damage ignores block.

[h2]Basic card additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Demonic Embrace - (Dispel) Take 5 damage. Deal double damage (based on original damage) for the rest of this battle.
[*] Fan the Flame - Apply 2 burn to all burned enemies.
[*] Meteor Shower - Deal 5 damage to a random enemy 3 times. (this might become a fusion card later)
[/list]

[h2]Fusion card additions[/h2]
[list]
[*] Risky Business - During the enemy's next turn, deal 4 piercing damage to all enemies each time daze triggers.
[*] Smoke Signal - Discard 1 fire card. Gain 1 spirit this turn. Draw 2 cards.
[*] Vile Embrace - Deal double damage (based on original damage) for the rest of this battle.
[*] Phoenix Rebirth - Permanently remove all copies of Phoenix Ashes and Phoenix Feathers from your deck. Gain the Phoenix Rebirth rune.
[/list]

[h2]Card changes[/h2]
[list]
[*] Aegis of Light: Increased block to 5 from 4.
[*] Celestial Strike -> Piercing Strike: Deal 6 piercing damage.
[*] Cold Snap -> Deal 8 piercing damage to all chilled enemies.
[/list]

[h2]New rune[/h2]
Phoenix Rebirth: Next time you would take lethal damage, consume this rune and gain half your maximum health.

notes.title: Hand of Anima Demo Update (Alpha 1.0.2)
notes.content:
[h2]Gameplay:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added overworld selection screen
[*] Escape key can now open and close the pause menu
[*] Optimized some load speeds and improved overall performance
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed issue where hovering over a player's status displayed a tooltip that went off the screen
[*] Fixed issue where removing a card from your deck permanently wasn't permanent
[*] Fixed issue with rapidly playing cards back to back resulting in errors
[*] Fixed issue with Mystic Forge not consistently displaying the player's deck
[*] Various additional minor bug fixes
[/list]

notes.title: Hand of Anima Demo is Live!
notes.content:
A huge thank you to everyone who volunteered to playtest and provide feedback in our Discord community. Your insight has been invaluable, and we'll keep using your feedback to help Hand of Anima reach its full potential.

[h2]Gameplay:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Added enemy intent indicators
[*] Added Mystic Forge map node - fuse cards outside of battle to permanently remove those 2 cards from your deck, but permanently gain the newly fused card in your deck.
[*] Added “Frenzy” status - while frenzied, a unit deals 50% more damage.
[*] Added “Dispel” keyword, with the description: A dispelled card can only be played once per battle, and will not be sent to your discard pile when played. It will return to your deck at the end of the battle.
[*] Added “Fusion” keyword, with the description: A fused card will not be sent to your discard pile. The cards used to create the fused card will be discarded normally.
[*] Removed all buttons from the bottom-left of the map screen
[*] Can no longer encounter any duplicate enemies in one run
[*] Changed card back (more options to come in a future update)
[*] Improved discard animation
[*] Improved draw animation
[*] Added alternate discard animation for dispelled and fused cards
[*] Notifications now adapt to the size of the text content
[*] Minor improvements to deck viewing
[*] Removed ability to hover over enemies for detailed information in battle
[*] Several minor asset ratio display improvements
[*] Several performance optimizations
[/list]

[h2]New Cards:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Earthquake + Earthquake = Tectonic Burst - 6 damage to all enemies
[*] Quick Draw + Quick Draw = Sleight of Hand - Discard 1 card. Draw 2 cards.
[*] Block + Block = Protect - Gain 6 block.
[*] Infected Wounds - Prevent an enemy from restoring health on their next turn.
[*] Cauterize - Restore 4 health. Apply 2 burn to yourself.
[*] Dissonant Swing - Deal 6 damage to an enemy with block.
[*] Frostbite + Frostbite = Freeze Ray - Apply 3 chill to the front enemy.
[*] Guiding Light = Dispel - Each time you fuse cards for the remainder of this battle, gain 2 block.
[/list]


[h2]Card Balance:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Twilight Eruption - Add effect: Apply 1 daze.
[*] Boiling Point - Increase damage to 5
[*] Combustion - Increase burn to 2
[*] Frostbite + Hailstorm = Flash Freeze - Deal 3 damage to all enemies. Apply 2 chill.
[*] Hailstorm - Decrease chill to 1.
[*] Glacial Fissure - Decrease chill to 1.
[*] Aegis of Light - Decrease block to 4.
[/list]

[h2]Bug fixes:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Fixed pulsing card issue when hovering the edge of cards on either end of your hand of cards
[*] Fixed bug where daze was not interrupting charged attacks when triggered
[*] Fixed inconsistent behaviors with discarding cards
[*] Fixed a rounding error with cards whose damage depends on health totals
[*] Fixed instances where, when scrolling in the deck view, the hovered card would not update until moving the mouse
[*] Fixed bug where cards could be clickable while discarding them
[*] Fixed bugs where spam clicking while drawing/discarding resulted in unexpected behavior
[*] Fixed bugs that would cause the battle to freeze
[*] Various additional minor bug fixes
[/list]

[h2]Optional Analytics:[/h2]
In this update, we added metric-driven gameplay analytics which can be opted into or out of at any time (gameplay data will only be collected if you actively consent). This data is completely anonymous, and is instrumental in helping us understand how well (or not well) the game is balanced. It paints a picture of gameplay elements like which cards are chosen most frequently, which enemies are too easy or difficult, and how often players defeat the boss in any given run. It would be a huge help if you would consent to these analytics to help us improve the game, but we completely understand if you do not wish to opt-in.
